text: dsh-canvas-flow 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端的无限画布工作流插件。它在 DSH 界面提供画布面板，并由宿主侧注册工具来创建项目、卡片、便利贴和卡片间的产物引用。画布支持文本、设计、Web 应用、图片、视频与音频卡片；卡片可读取上游材料、编辑设计节点、生成媒体并导出产物。适合希望把多步骤内容制作放在可视化画布上协作的 DSH 用户。安装后，媒体生成需在 DSH 模型配置中提供可用路线及凭证；未配置媒体路线时仍可使用其他画布功能。

dsh-canvas-flow is a workflow canvas for DeepSeek Harness. Create projects and text, design, app, image, video, and audio cards, then connect artifacts as references. Agents can reuse upstream content, edit designs, generate media, and export work. Media uses routes configured in DSH settings.
想在 DSH 里把文档、设计稿和应用页面放到同一张画布上管理。

能不能在设计稿里指定图层并让 agent 精确编辑？
我想在同一工作区生成图片、短视频或音频并保留为卡片产物。
需要把卡片产物导出成 PDF、图片或压缩包。
I want to connect project artifacts as visual inputs to downstream cards.
Can an agent generate and organize text, design, and app artifacts on one canvas?
I need to review upstream card content and reuse it in another card conversation.
I want image, video, or audio outputs saved as workspace artifacts.
dsh-canvas-flow 的功能「画布项目」：在 Web 客户端打开项目画布，查看卡片、项目产物与引用关系，并创建便利贴、卡片或应用和设计节点。
dsh-canvas-flow 的功能「卡片引用」：卡片可声明上游产物引用，读取直接来源摘要或把摘要注入会话，让下游创作使用已有材料。
dsh-canvas-flow 的功能「设计节点编辑」：设计卡片可读取场景图结构，再以节点操作批量修改指定图层及其属性。
dsh-canvas-flow 的功能「媒体生成」：为图片、视频或音频卡片提交描述生成媒体产物；可按引用图片作为生成参考，视频任务等待异步结果。
dsh-canvas-flow 的功能「产物导出」：调用导出工具将支持的卡片产物保存为 HTML、PDF、PPTX、PNG、SVG 或 ZIP，具体格式受卡片类型与部署能力限制。
dsh-canvas-flow 使用前须知：媒体请求发送至所选模型路线的服务，凭证由 DSH credentials 解析；未配置路线与凭证时不能生成媒体。（见 src/host/media-provider.ts:330-341）

dsh-canvas-flow README · dsh-canvas-flow：**English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

> **Build your workflow on an infinite canvas.**
> Drag cards into a flow, connect them to pass data, and watch every step happen.

**dsh-canvas-flow** is an **infinite canvas plugin** running on [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): a whole project lives on one canvas — text cards write specs, design cards produce design drafts, app cards build runnable web applications, and you can refine any element right in the preview.

dsh-canvas-flow README · dsh-canvas-flow：Cards reference each other through connected edges: upstream artifacts feed directly into downstream cards, and a few cards working together can carry large, complex tasks.

---

dsh-canvas-flow README · Features：- Generate requirement documents with text cards, website designs or presentations with design cards, web applications with app cards, and images / videos with media cards.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Features：- **The project folder is organized by card type**: artifacts no longer sit flat in the canvas root — text goes to `docs/`, apps to `apps/`, designs to `designs/`, images to `images/`, videos to `videos/`, audio to `audio/` (plus `data/`, `files/`, `folders/`).
  Older canvases are **tidied automatically the first time you open them**: only items sitting flat in the root are moved, one item per entry, with a numeric suffix on name clashes; anything that cannot be moved stays where it is. The root `index.html` and subdirectories you have already organized are left untouched.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Features：- Every card type supports export.
  - Text cards: export as Markdown, plain text, Word, or PDF documents.

- Design cards: export as Figma files, images, PDF, or PowerPoint.

- App cards: export the web application as a zip archive — double-click `index.html` to run it.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Installing the plugin：Install the plugin from the DeepSeek Harness client.
Search for `dsh-canvas-flow` in the plugin marketplace and click install.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：| Capability | Status |
|------|------|
| **Text** | The agent writes Markdown documents; export as Markdown, plain text, Word, or PDF |
| **Design** | The agent produces design drafts and makes precise second-pass edits to specific layers. Export as Figma files, images, PDF, or PPT |
| **App** | The agent writes web application code that runs directly in the DeepSeek Harness client. Pick any element and the agent precisely edits that element's code |
| **Image** | The agent generates images (Jimeng / Seedream) onto the card's artifact, with image-to-image via reference edges; keep talking in the session to keep iterating. Export the original image, or import one from your machine as the artifact |
| **Video** | The agent generates short videos (Jimeng / Seedance) with aspect ratio, duration, and resolution controls; a per-minute async task you wait on. Export the original clip, or import one from your machine |
| **Audio** | The agent generates audio (Doubao `doubao-seed-audio-1-0`): dialogue, sound effects, music, and ambience all go into one prompt; synchronous, up to 120 seconds per call. Export the original file |

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：Media generation uses **the host's own model configuration**: add a provider route in DeepSeek Harness's model settings that can serve Seedream / Seedance / Seed-Audio (fill in `baseURL` and `apiKeyEnv`) — no plugin-side configuration needed.
When no usable route is found, the card tells you exactly what it searched by and where to add one.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：One thing to know about audio: `doubao-seed-audio-1-0` is listed in Ark's model marketplace, but **the API lives in Doubao Speech** — its endpoint and key are not the same set as Ark's (auth is `X-Api-Key`, not Bearer). A dedicated route is recommended:

```yaml
doubao-audio:
  apiKeyEnv: ARK_AUDIO_KEY        # the API Key from the speech console
  baseURL: https://openspeech.bytedance.com/api/v3
  models:

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：A single Ark route can also work (the plugin re-routes audio requests to the speech host), provided that key is valid on both sides; if it is not, the 401 message tells you exactly which route to add.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：**The card face is the artifact itself**: an image card is the image; video and audio cards carry their native players — play them here, drag the progress bar. Every card on the canvas shares one size, **400×252**, and the media card face is **exactly 16:9**: the face is the picture. In a 200-wide card a 16:9 image is a narrow strip; and if the height were doubled (280), a 16:9 image would leave a band of background above and below — so the height is derived from the panel's 16:9 (398×224 + 26 card header + 2 border). Audio cards share the same size (one rhythm across the canvas since v1.79). The card face and the double-click full-screen preview **read the same artifact and say the same things** (file not yet generated / file too large).

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：**"Which model powers this conversation" and "which model generated this card" are two different things that one dropdown asks**: on text / design / app cards it selects the model for the session's next request (so only conversational models are listed — picking Seedream / Seedance there would only fail the next turn); on image / video / audio cards it selects **which model generates this card**, listing only that family (Seedream on image cards, Seedance on video cards), stored on the card itself and **never touching the session**. Unset, it shows "auto", meaning pick by model family from the DSH model configuration above. When set, it is really used — if the configuration no longer has it, the card reports an error honestly (it never silently switches to another model); the choice travels with the work, and opening the same folder on another machine keeps it.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Shipped：**One reference image is all image-to-image / image-to-video needs**: connect an edge from an image card to another image or video card, and on generation that edge becomes the reference (the `image` input for image-to-image, the first frame for video) — no need to publish the image as a URL first. For video you can also choose whether it is the first frame (default), the last frame, or a reference image.

dsh-canvas-flow README · Next up：| Capability | Plan |
|------|------|
| **Media editing desk** | Inpainting / outpainting / matting for images, first & last frame plus camera control for videos — as parameter panels on the node, not just conversation requests |

dsh-canvas-flow README · dsh-canvas-flow：[English](./README.md) | **简体中文**

> **在画布上，搭出你的工作流。**
> 拖拽成流程，连线传数据，每一步都看得见。

**dsh-canvas-flow** 是跑在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 上的**无限画布插件**：一个项目铺在同一张画布上 —— 文本卡片写规范、设计卡片出设计稿、应用卡片做出能跑的 Web 应用，还能在预览里按元素精修。

卡片之间用连线引用，上游的产物直接喂给下游，几个卡片配合起来就能完成大型复杂任务。

---

dsh-canvas-flow README · 主要功能：- 通过文本卡片生成需求文档，通过设计卡片生成网站设计或者 PPT，通过应用卡片生成 web 应用，通过图片 / 视频卡片生成画面与短片。

- **项目目录按卡片类型分文件夹**：产物不再平铺在画布根上——文本进 `docs/`、应用进 `apps/`、设计进 `designs/`、图片进 `images/`、视频进 `videos/`、音频进 `audio/`（另有 `data/`、`files/`、`folders/`）。
  老画布**第一次打开时自动整理**：只搬平铺在根上的条目，一件一条、撞名加序号、搬不动就留在原地；根上的 `index.html` 与你已经整理好的子目录都不动。

- 所有卡片类型都支持导出。
  - 文本卡片：支持导出 Markdown、纯文本本文档、Word 文档、PDF 文档。

- 设计卡片：支持导出 Figma 文件、图片、PDF、PPT。

- 应用卡片：支持导出 web 应用压缩包，双击 index.html 运行即可。

dsh-canvas-flow README · 安装插件：在 DeepSeek Harness 客户端中安装插件。
在插件市场中搜索 dsh-canvas-flow，点击安装即可。

dsh-canvas-flow README · 已实现：| 能力 | 现状 |
|------|------|
| **文本** | Agent 生成 Markdown 文档，支持导出 Markdown 文档、纯文本本文档、Word 文档、PDF 文档 |
| **设计** | Agent 生成设计稿， Agent 精确二次修改指定图层。可导出 Figma 文件、图片、PDF、PPT |
| **应用** | Agent 生成 web 应用代码，支持直接在 DeepSeek Harness 客户端运行。支持指定元素， Agent 精确二次修改指定元素的代码。 |
| **图片** | Agent 生成画面（即梦 / Seedream），落在卡片产物上，支持图生图；会话里接着说就接着改。可导出原图，也可从本机导入一张当产物 |
| **视频** | Agent 生成短片（即梦 / Seedance），可给比例、时长、分辨率；按分钟计的异步任务，等它跑完。可导出原片，也可从本机导入一段 |
| **音频** | Agent 生成音频（豆包 `doubao-seed-audio-1-0`）：对白、音效、配乐、环境声写进一条 prompt；同步返回，单次最长 120 秒。可导出原文件 |

dsh-canvas-flow README · 已实现：媒体节点的生成走**宿主自己的模型配置**：在 DeepSeek Harness 的模型设置里加一条能服务
Seedream / Seedance / Seed-Audio 的 provider 路线（填好 `baseURL` 与 `apiKeyEnv`）即可，插件这边不用改配置。
找不到可用路线时，卡片会如实说出「按什么找的、去哪儿加」。

音频注意一件事：`doubao-seed-audio-1-0` 挂在方舟的模型广场上，但**接口在豆包语音**——
地址、密钥与方舟都不是同一套（鉴权是 `X-Api-Key`，不是 Bearer）。推荐给它单独一条路线：

```yaml
doubao-audio:
  apiKeyEnv: ARK_AUDIO_KEY        # 语音控制台拿到的 API Key
  baseURL: https://openspeech.bytedance.com/api/v3
  models:

只写一条方舟路线也能跑（插件会把音频请求改投语音那条主机），前提是那把 key 两边都认；
不认时 401 的文案会直接告诉你该去加哪一条。

dsh-canvas-flow README · 已实现：**卡片上直接就是产物本身**：图片卡是那张图，视频卡与音频卡各是它们的原生播放器——能在这里
播，也能拖进度条。全画布只有一种卡片尺寸**400×252**，媒体卡的卡面**正好 16:9**：卡面就是画面，
200 宽里一张 16:9 的图只剩一条窄带；而高度若按两倍（280），16:9 的图上下会各空出一条底色
——高度得由面板 16:9 反推（398×224 + 卡头 26 + 边框 2）。音频卡与别的卡同尺寸（v1.79 起全画布只有一种节拍）。卡面与双击全屏**读的是同一条产物、说同一批话**（文件还没生成 / 文件过大）。

dsh-canvas-flow README · 已实现：**「这段对话用哪个模型」与「这张卡由哪个模型生成」是两件事，同一个下拉框问两件事**：文本 /
设计 / 应用卡上，它选的是这段会话下一次请求用哪个模型（所以只列能对话的——Seedream / Seedance
选进去只会让下一次对话失败）；图片 / 视频 / 音频卡上，它选的是**这张卡由哪个模型生成**，只列
这一族（图片卡列 Seedream、视频卡列 Seedance），写在这张卡自己身上，**不碰会话**。没选过时
显示「自动」，意思是按模型族去上面那条 DSH 模型配置里挑。选了就真的用这个——配置里没有它时
卡片会如实报错（不会悄悄换一个去画）；这个选择跟着作品走，换台机器打开同一份目录仍然生效。

**引用一张图就能图生图 / 图生视频**：从图片卡连一条线到图片卡或视频卡，生成时那条边就变成
参考图（图像生图的 `image`、视频的首帧）——不用先把图发布成链接。视频还能指定它是首帧
（默认）、尾帧还是参考图。
